title.narrative: Adalit Libya

description.narrative: The overall objective of the proposed action is to promote justice and the rule of law in Libya specifically by: (1)   Contributing to improve the functioning of the justice system with particular focus on vulnerable groups¿ access to justice and fair trial; (2)   Reinforcing the capacity of the Libyan Government and CSOs to report on human rights violations and to interact with international and regional Human Rights Mechanisms (HRMs); and (3)   Supporting the efforts of concerned stakeholders, including State and non-governmental actors, to ensure systematic follow-up and implementation of human rights recommendations, in particular those related to the justice system, transitional justice, accountability and fight against impunity.
